Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 登总持阁 — 岑参
高阁逼诸天，登临近日边。
晴开万井树，愁看五陵烟。
槛外低秦岭，牕中小渭川。
蚤知清净理，常愿奉金仙。
No text or seal in any corner; all scrolls and paper must be unmarked. Exactly two hands for each person, realistic hands, limbs and horses.
